JiwaDocument.Name: User Profile Copy On Login
JiwaDocument.Description: Plugin creates a Staff custom field, type lookup, which can be cleared or point to some other staff member. Upon login, the user settings of the staff member pointed to are read in and used for the staff member being logged in. This allows for the creation of template users which define form layouts, custom columns, etc.
JiwaDocument.Author: Jiwa Financials

CustomField.Name: TemplateProfile
CustomField.Description: The profile (form layouts, custom columns, etc.) information is copied from this staff member upon login.
